rationale: redirect_pydantic is registered through the in-repo FastAPI decorator @app.get("/pydantic", ...). The tutorial test imports this module's app and issues client.get("/pydantic"), and FastAPI's own router dispatches that request to the endpoint, so in-repo code drives the call. framework-flask-route is limited to Flask @app.route/@blueprint.route, and registration-decorator-dispatch explicitly excludes dotted HTTP-route shortcuts such as @app.post, so no in-scope rule covers it.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The single prior verdict (fp-novel, FastAPI route registration exercised by the TestClient test) is correct.
